items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: But the brass was Big Jim and Bill Matthews, and Old Man Allen, and Louis, and myself.

ctx.x: I got all that on that sketch when I sent him to England. I know there was twelve of us, that's for sure. But the brass was Big Jim and Bill Matthews, and Old Man Allen, and Louis, and myself. It was twelve men. What numbers did you play? Do you remember? Well we played for a few of them, Flea's Abide. That was the few of them we played at the cemetery. The next day we played the blues and different other numbers, St. Louis blues and something else. From Night Down, a real cemetery, back to Algae. We took the…
You must have been a lot of places in this country, I mean, in addition to Europe.
